entity: US political committees raising $1M+ from individuals in 2024 while passing under 10% to candidates or ads (the class)

why: Bonica and The Nation report the same finding, same direction, overlapping window: spam PACs raising hundreds of millions and delivering about 1.6% to campaigns. His 145-PAC set is a different definition, not a contradiction; our 92/$580M/treasurer stats are stated nowhere.
